landing.problemsTitle: If you're ARMY, this has happened to you
landing.problem1: Ever showed up late to a presale because you didn't know it already started?
landing.problem2: Missed a live because you couldn't find it by date or title?
landing.problem3: Frustrated paying for translations that should be free?

landing.problem5: Worried about being left out and feeling like you're not as on-top-of-it as other ARMY?
landing.agitation1: It's not just a sold-out ticket. It's paying 3-5x more on resale, or missing the concert entirely. An active ARMY faces 8-12 windows like this every year — presales, comebacks, renewals.
landing.agitation2Rest: when you depend on finding out from Twitter or a Discord group you might check too late.
landing.agitationStatLabel: key windows per year an active ARMY can miss without a system that alerts them in time
landing.solutionTitle: It's not that you don't care enough
landing.solutionBody: It's that HYBE spreads the information across Weverse, Bubble, Twitter, and announcements that nobody centralizes. KIVO Radar does it for you.
landing.step1Desc: Tickets, membership, comebacks, lives — you decide what to be alerted about.
landing.step2Desc: We check the official sources so you don't have to.
landing.step3Desc: 48h and 1h before, with the exact guide for what to do on each platform.
landing.offerTitle: All of this, for less than a coffee a month
landing.faqQ1: Isn't this the same as Weverse?
landing.faqA1: No. Weverse streams content; KIVO organizes it and tells you when and how to act on Weverse, Bubble, and every other platform.
landing.faqQ2: Is KIVO official BTS or HYBE content?
landing.faqA2: No. KIVO is 100% fan-made, not affiliated with HYBE — that's why we focus on what's useful to you, not what's convenient for them to sell.
landing.faqQ3: Why pay if I can get it for free on TikTok or Reddit?
landing.faqA3: Because there it arrives scattered and late. KIVO gathers it and alerts you BEFORE it slips by — your time matters too.
landing.faqQ4: Will it last, or will it disappear like ARMY Amino did?
landing.faqA4: We ship updates every week and share our roadmap with the community. This isn't a project that gets abandoned.
landing.faqQ5: Is it expensive / not sure I'll use it enough?
landing.faqA5: Less than a coffee a month — and you get 7 days free to try it before anything gets charged.
landing.finalTitle: Imagine opening your phone already knowing exactly what to do
landing.finalBody: No more refreshing 3 apps in the middle of the night. Just you, calm, with your reminder already set — the ARMY who's on top of it, not the one who finds out late.
landing.finalPrice: $1.67/mo, 7 days free, no tricks — cancel anytime
landing.ps: PS: KIVO Radar alerts you to every BTS presale before it sells out. Today you get KIVO Guide and KIVO Community included, the First Presale Guarantee, and 7 days free before anything is charged.
landing.footerDisclaimer: KIVO is an independent, fan-made project with no affiliation to HYBE, BIGHIT MUSIC, or BTS. We don't use official copyrighted content; all information is based on public sources.

legal.privacyContent:
KIVO is an independent fan-made project, not affiliated with HYBE, BIGHIT MUSIC, or BTS. This policy explains what data we collect and what we do with it.

## What data we collect

- Your email address, to create your account and send you access links
- Your answers to the onboarding quiz (which platforms you use, what you care about), to personalize your Radar
- The events you save or subscribe to
- What you post in KIVO Community (posts, comments)
- The reports you submit through KIVO Safe

## How we use your data

- To give you access to the app and personalize your experience
- To send you the alerts you asked for (event reminders)
- To process your payment, through Hotmart
- To moderate the community and prevent spam or abuse

KIVO does not use artificial intelligence anywhere in the product — your data is never sent to an AI provider.

## Who we share data with

We never sell your data. We only share it with the providers that make KIVO work:

- Hotmart, which processes your payment — we never see or store your card number
- Supabase, which hosts our database
- Resend, which sends our emails
- Vercel, which hosts the application

## How long we keep your data

For as long as your account is active. If you delete it, we remove your personal data within 30 days. Some payment records are kept by Hotmart under its own policy, for tax requirements outside our control.

## Your rights

You can access, correct, delete, or object to the use of your data at any time. Write to us at soporte@kivoapp.app and we'll take care of it.

## Minors

KIVO is intended for people 13 and older. If you're under 18, you need a parent or guardian's permission to pay for a subscription — Hotmart already requires this at checkout. We do not knowingly collect data from children under 13.

## Changes to this policy

If we change anything important, we'll let you know by email or with a notice inside the app.

## Contact

soporte@kivoapp.app
legal.termsContent:
By creating an account or using KIVO, you agree to these terms.

## What KIVO is

KIVO is an independent fan-made app that helps international ARMY keep up with BTS presales, comebacks, and membership renewals. It is not an official HYBE, BIGHIT MUSIC, or BTS product, and has no affiliation with them. We don't use official copyrighted content; all information is based on public sources.

## What we don't promise

- We don't guarantee ticket availability or any third-party product
- We don't control official platforms (Weverse, Bubble, and similar) — we only help you stay organized around them
- Information may contain errors or delays; always confirm with the official source before making an important decision

## Your account

- You must provide a real, valid email address
- You're responsible for keeping your session secure
- We may suspend or close accounts that violate these terms (spam, harassment, fraud)

## Acceptable use of KIVO Community

Prohibited: harassment, illegal content, spam, impersonation, sexual content involving minors, and hate speech. Violations may result in a warning, suspension, or account closure, without refund.

## Subscription and payments

- KIVO is sold as a subscription through Hotmart
- It renews automatically every month or year, depending on your plan, until you cancel
- You can cancel anytime from your Hotmart buyer portal (consumer.hotmart.com)
- 7-day trial: if you don't cancel before it ends, your first payment is charged automatically. We email you before that happens.

## Limitation of liability

KIVO is provided "as is." We are not liable for losses arising from errors in the information, service outages, or decisions you make based on the app. Always use your own judgment and verify with official sources before buying tickets or making important decisions.

## Intellectual property

All of KIVO's own content (brand, design, code) belongs to us. We claim no rights over HYBE, BIGHIT MUSIC, or BTS official content.

## Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of Colombia.

## Contact

soporte@kivoapp.app
legal.refundContent:
## Trial period

KIVO offers a 7-day free trial on both plans (monthly and annual). Nothing is charged during those 7 days. If you cancel before it ends, you're never charged.

## After the first charge

Once the first charge happens (when the trial ends, or on each renewal), Hotmart's own refund terms apply, since it's our payment processor:

- You have the right to request a refund within 7 days of the purchase, a guarantee Hotmart applies in several countries
- To request it, go to your buyer portal at consumer.hotmart.com, or write to us at soporte@kivoapp.app and we'll help you directly

## What happens to your access

Once the refund is processed, your account automatically returns to the free plan. We don't delete your data or history.

## Cancellation is not the same as a refund

Cancelling stops future renewals, but doesn't refund the period you already paid for — you keep Pro access until the end of the cycle you already paid. You can cancel anytime from your Hotmart buyer portal.

## Contact

soporte@kivoapp.app
